meta.method: GitHub REST assets from the latest stable release and the latest prerelease, plus README download links/install commands where the class is not releases-only, for curated data points in the selected application classes. Asset names and install managers map to the platform key. Non-GitHub entries are retained as not-collected; unavailable repositories are not treated as having no packages.
limits: A package name or install command does not prove that the package installs, runs or matches the target.
Release asset names can be ambiguous; .zip/.7z without an OS hint are recorded as other.
README links are only collected when they name the target software; unrelated links are ignored.
Non-GitHub pages and the automated scan index were not collected in this snapshot.
Game Dev entries read release assets only; their README install commands are not collected.
Collection date and per-entry checked_at describe the public metadata, not a runtime test.
